name: Drawn line chart
what: A dashed grid with two axes and the names stacked under it stands on a dark page; a thick line is drawn from point to point in bursts, and every point shows its number counting up, until the whole jagged line is there; the chart floats a few pixels to the end.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0 the grid, the axes and the names are already there; the line starts at the first point f3 and is drawn point to point in bursts (f3-f16, f26-f38, f47-f58, f66-f76, ... one every ~20 f, each ~10 f, a steep S-curve with soft ends, updated every 2nd frame); each point's number fades in and counts up (f7, f26, f45, f63, ... one every ~18 f, ~6 f to count); the line is complete at f218; the whole chart floats about 10 px to the end (f0-f299)

tracks.name: line
tracks.what: the thick line is drawn from point to point, in bursts
tracks.easing: steep S-curve per segment (cubic-bezier(0.5, 0.2, 0.38, 0.99)), ~10 f each, every ~20 f, on twos

tracks.name: numbers
tracks.what: each point's number fades in and counts up to its value
tracks.easing: cubed count (slow start, fast end), ~6 f each, one every ~18 f

tracks.name: float
tracks.what: the grid, the line and the names float together up to ~16 px (at 1280 wide)
